plan.title: SRC-CRE-026 Forward Auction Rejects Letter Quantity

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type to a forward auction; price-based auction is the closest explicit forward-auction configuration.
Provide the required event title before configuring the sheet.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the requested product and enter the invalid letters value in Quantity Requested; the step exits the cell with Tab and records the inline validation.
Assert that the application rejects the non-numeric quantity and reports a quantity-related error immediately.
